importDir.description: Folder scanned for an unzipped Instagram 'Download your information' export in JSON format (any messages/inbox/<thread>/message_N.json beneath it). Relative paths resolve from the Shale project root; ~/ is supported.

syncEnabled.description: Fetch recent DMs with the instagrapi sidecar on the instagram-sync cron, using the account connected on the Accounts page. Uses Instagram's private API, which can trigger security challenges or account restrictions; use at your own risk.

pythonBin.description: Python interpreter with instagrapi installed. Empty uses the virtualenv created by `bun run setup instagram` (data/instagram/venv), falling back to python3.

sessionFile.description: Where the sidecar stores the instagrapi session so it does not log in on every run.

usernameEnv.description: Fallback environment variable (e.g. in data/.env) for the Instagram username, used only when no account is connected on the Accounts page.

passwordEnv.description: Fallback environment variable (e.g. in data/.env) for the Instagram password, used only when no account is connected on the Accounts page.

maxThreadsPerSync.description: Most recently active threads checked per sync.

maxMessagesPerThread.description: Maximum messages fetched per thread per sync.

syncTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum run time of one sidecar invocation.

gapMinutes.description: A silence longer than this starts a new conversation window (one searchable source per window).

maxWindowChars.description: Maximum transcript characters per window; keep at or below 12000 so whole windows stay searchable.

idleMinutes.description: The newest window of a conversation is indexed only after this much silence.

summarize.description: Summarise each window with the chat LLM; otherwise a heuristic summary is used.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for window summaries. Empty uses the default.

namespace.description: Namespace for Instagram sources and graph entities.
